title: NASA Ames Fire Department Aircraft Firefighting Training
description: The fire department at NASA’s Ames Research Center in California’s Silicon Valley will perform training on the Moffett Federal Airfield beginning Tuesday, Sept. 8 through Friday, Sept. 11.
